name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore’s northern shore, Beached Sea Turtle remains untouched by nearby Greymist murlocs. A sample is carried to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon. Naturalists and priestesses seek to learn why great sea creatures wash ashore and scavengers leave them alone.

sections.title: A Curious Absence
sections.body: Greymist murlocs crowd Darkshore’s northern coast and scavenge whatever food washes up from the Veiled Sea. Yet the great turtle’s skeleton lies mostly untouched. Those studying the shore wonder whether the murlocs missed it or avoided it for some unknown reason.

sections.title: Study of the Shoreline
sections.body: In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers samples from beached sea turtles for the Temple of the Moon. The night elf priestesses study the disturbances in Darkshore’s waters. Skeletal fragments may help them learn whether sickness, magic, or dangerous sea predators are killing the ancient creatures.

faq.q: What is the beached sea turtle?
faq.answer: It is the skeletal remains of an ancient sea turtle washed ashore in northern Darkshore. Its unusual presence and the lack of scavengers have drawn the night elves’ attention.

faq.q: Why are the murlocs avoiding the carcass?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs usually scavenge beach carcasses, but they have left these remains alone. No one knows whether they missed it or are avoiding it for an unknown reason. Gwennyth finds their absence worth remembering as the remains are studied.
Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf researcher in Auberdine who gathers samples of Darkshore’s beached sea life for the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: Why does the Temple of the Moon care about beached sea creatures?
faq.answer: The Temple of the Moon studies beached sea creatures because they are dying in unusual numbers along Darkshore. Its priestesses analyze samples to find what is harming the seas.

faq.q: Where is this particular sea turtle located?
faq.answer: The carcass rests on Darkshore’s northern coast, near territory inhabited by Greymist murloc tribes.

faq.q: Are there other beached creatures along Darkshore?
faq.answer: Yes. Several beached sea creatures, including giant sea turtles, lie along Darkshore’s shores. Auberdine’s researchers are investigating why these ocean giants are dying.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see unexplained deaths and scavengers avoiding sea creatures along Darkshore, signs of growing imbalance in kaldorei lands.
As a druid, you watch the coastline closely. Murlocs leaving the dead untouched may signal an unnatural taint in the waters.
As a priest, you extend Elune’s care to all living things and investigate deaths that disturb nature’s balance.
